description: List memory documents (optionally under a path prefix), sorted by path. Returns path, size, and last-updated time for each.
name: mcp__memory__memory_list

cursor.description: Path of the last entry from a previous call.

include_preview.description: If true, include a one-line preview of each file's content.

path_prefix.description: Optional path prefix to filter results (e.g. /topics/).
